<view class="screen management-page rating-discussion-media">
  <view class="management-context">
    <view class="management-context-icon">
      <wu-icon name="image" tone="accent" size="22" />

    <view class="management-context-copy">
      <view class="context-title">
        {{composerOpen ? '当前图片草稿' : '评价与回复'}}
      </view>
      <view class="meta">
        评分图片讨论
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <view class="notice">
    评价最多 9 图，回复最多 3 图，可只发图片。每次选择一张，上传准备好后再选下一张。
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{error}}" class="notice">
    {{error}}
  </view>
  <view class="notice">
    {{editor.message}}
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{noticePreview}}" class="card">
    <view>
      {{noticePreview.author}}
    </view>
    <view>
      {{noticePreview.body}}
    </view>
    <view>
      当前图片数量：{{noticePreview.imageCount}}
    </view>
  </view>
  <button wx:if="{{subscription.status === 'known'}}" bindtap="onSubscription" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen || editor.selected.length}}" class="management-action">
    {{subscription.subscribed ? '取消订阅' : '订阅目标更新'}}
  </button>
  <button bindtap="onRefresh" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-quiet">
    重新核验当前范围
  </button>
  <button wx:if="{{canCompose || recovery || editor.selected.length}}" bindtap="onCompose" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-primary">
    {{editor.selected.length ? '继续原图片草稿' : '撰写当前评价 / 回复'}}
  </button>
  <view class="chips">
    <button data-sort="time" bindtap="onSort" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action management-choice">
      最新评价
    </button>
    <button data-sort="likes" bindtap="onSort" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action management-choice">
      按赞排序
    </button>
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{composerOpen}}" class="card management-editor">
    <view class="section-title">
      当前草稿（最多 {{maximum}} 图）
    </view>
    <button wx:for="{{authorModes}}" wx:key="*this" data-mode="{{item}}" bindtap="onAuthorMode" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-action management-choice {{authorMode === item ? 'is-selected' : ''}}">
      {{item === 'named' ? '公开昵称' : '本目标分身'}}
    </button>
    <textarea value="{{text}}" bindinput="onText" maxlength="-1" placeholder="正文最多 500 字，也可以只发图片" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" />
    <view wx:for="{{editor.selected}}" wx:key="memberId" class="management-image-row">
      <view>
        第 {{index + 1}} 张：{{item.ready ? '已准备好' : '需要恢复'}}
      </view>
      <button data-id="{{item.memberId}}" bindtap="onRemove" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-action">
        移除
      </button>
      <button data-id="{{item.memberId}}" data-direction="-1" bindtap="onMove" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-action">
        上移
      </button>
      <button data-id="{{item.memberId}}" data-direction="1" bindtap="onMove" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-action">
        下移
      </button>
    </view>
    <view wx:if="{{editor.upload.active}}">
      {{editor.upload.status}} {{editor.upload.progress}}%
    </view>
    <button bindtap="onChoose" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen || editor.selected.length &gt;= maximum}}" class="management-action">
      选择并上传下一张
    </button>
    <button bindtap="onPublish" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen || !authorMode || (!text &amp;&amp; !editor.selected.length)}}" class="management-primary">
      确认发布完整内容
    </button>
    <button bindtap="onCloseComposer" class="management-quiet">
      关闭并清空本地正文
    </button>
  </view>
  <view wx:for="{{rows}}" wx:key="id" class="card management-post">
    <view class="author">
      {{item.author}}
    </view>
    <view class="body">
      {{item.body}}
    </view>
    <button wx:if="{{item.imageCount}}" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="onImage" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
      查看完整图片组（{{item.imageCount}} 张）
    </button>
    <button wx:if="{{likes[item.id].status === 'known'}}" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="onLike" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen || editor.selected.length}}" class="management-action">
      {{likes[item.id].liked ? '取消赞' : '赞'}} {{likes[item.id].count}}
    </button>
    <button data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="onDelete" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-action">
      作者 / 管理员删除选项
    </button>
    <button wx:if="{{!item.reply}}" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="onThread" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
      打开讨论
    </button>
    <button wx:if="{{item.reply &amp;&amp; item.canReply}}" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="onCompose" disabled="{{busy || editor.frozen}}" class="management-primary">
      回复这一条
    </button>
  </view>
  <button wx:if="{{hasMore}}" bindtap="onMore" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
    继续读取
  </button>
  <view wx:if="{{gallery.open}}" class="modal-mask">
    <view class="modal">
      <image wx:if="{{gallery.localSrc}}" class="discussion-image" mode="aspectFit" src="{{gallery.localSrc}}" />
      <view wx:else>
        图片正在核验或暂不可用
      </view>
      <view>
        {{gallery.index + 1}} / {{gallery.count}}
      </view>
      <button bindtap="onPreviousImage" disabled="{{gallery.index === 0}}" class="management-action">
        上一张
      </button>
      <button bindtap="onNextImage" disabled="{{gallery.index + 1 &gt;= gallery.count}}" class="management-action">
        下一张
      </button>
      <button bindtap="onCloseImage" class="management-quiet">
        关闭并释放图片
      </button>
    </view>
  </view>
  <navigator url="/pages/rating-recovery/rating-recovery" class="management-link">
    旧版本原请求恢复
    <wu-icon name="chevron-right" tone="muted" size="22" />
  </navigator>
  <view class="card management-recovery">
    <view class="section-title">
      原图片请求
    </view>
    <button bindtap="onRecover" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-primary">
      查询原业务回执并恢复图片
    </button>
    <button bindtap="onRetry" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
      以原编号重试已冻结发布
    </button>
    <button bindtap="onRequestCancel" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
      明确取消原请求
    </button>
    <view wx:if="{{cancelConfirmation}}" class="management-confirmation" aria-role="alert">
      <view class="notice">
        只在服务端明确关闭原请求、图片批次且原生上传完成后释放记录。已经发布的内容不会被伪装为取消。
      </view>
      <button bindtap="onCancelOriginal" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-destructive">
        确认取消原请求
      </button>
      <button bindtap="onDismissCancel" class="management-action">
        返回
      </button>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
